program.help:
Second-pass spike detection with mask exclusion and IN-PLACE shadow clustering. Detects additional low-amplitude spikes missed by the main detection pass, then classifies each new spike into the "shadow" of its nearest existing cluster (by robust Mahalanobis distance) or into a single unmatched bin. The new spikes are merged directly into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N — no parallel stem.
PIPELINE
1. process_reextractspikes scans $session.fil using per-group thresholds derived by scaling process_medianthreshold's baseline by reextractThresholdFactor. Any candidate peak within ± reextractMaskHalfWidth samples of a timestamp already listed in $session.res.N is rejected. New spikes land at $session-reextr-tmp.{res,spk}.N.
2. Originals are copied to $session...bak for crash recovery the first time the script runs. Subsequent runs preserve the earlier .bak files.
3. process_shadowcluster merges the new spikes into the primary session files. Writes go to .tmp files first and are renamed atomically, so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the originals.
CLUSTER ID CONVENTION
shadow(k) = maxExistingId + 1 + k (paired with existing cluster k) unmatched = maxExistingId + 1 + maxExistingId + 1
PREREQUISITES
The primary detection + PCA + clustering pipeline must have completed first. Required input files per group N: $session.res.N $session.spk.N $session.fet.N $session.clu.N $session.pca.N
The following parameters are inherited from ndm_extractspikes: thresholdFactor refractoryPeriod peakSearchLength start / duration (for baseline estimation)
PARAMETERS
# reextractThresholdFactor (default: 0.75)
Scale factor applied to the per-group median-threshold baseline to obtain the re-extraction threshold. Lower values recover more low-amplitude events but also admit more noise crossings. Typical range: 0.5 .. 0.9.
# reextractMaskHalfWidth (default: refractoryPeriod)
Minimum sample distance a new candidate peak must maintain from every original spike timestamp. Defaults to the main refractory period.
# reextractMinClusterSize (default: 50)
Existing clusters with fewer members are not eligible as parents for shadow assignment (median / MAD statistics unreliable below this).
# reextractChi2 (default: 0.9999)
χ² quantile for the squared-Mahalanobis admission threshold. Lower is stricter; higher is permissive. The 0.9999 default matches the per-dim-MAD + χ² calibration used elsewhere in neurosuite-3.
# reextractExtraFeat (default: auto)
Whether the reference .fet.N includes the per-channel peak features appended by process_pca -x: auto (inferred from dimensionality), 0, or 1. Normal users leave this on auto.
OUTPUT
Merges in-place into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N. Originals are preserved at $session...bak on first run — rename them back over the primary files to revert.
NEXT STEPS
Open $session in klusters to review the shadow clusters and either merge them into their parents, tune them as separate units, or reject them.
SEE ALSO
ndm_reextractspikes_stderiv — spatial+temporal derivative variant.
